newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson signs 508 mln SKR Russia deal.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson signs 508 mln SKR Russia deal.

text.p: Swedish telecoms company LM Ericsson said on Wednesday it had signed an AXE contract with Russian telecommunications operator AO MGST worth 508 million crowns or $66 million.
The contract includes AXE switching equipment and services during 1997-98, Ericsson said in a statement.
Ericsson said AO MGTS is the Moscow city network public operator and the country's largest operator of fixed telecom networks.
"This contract makes Ericsson one of the leading suppliers to the telecom networks in Moscow," said Gunnar Forsgren, spokesman for Ericsson Public Networks, in the statement.
Ericsson has some 300 employees in Russia.
